package domain_test

import (
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
)

func TestDialogTeacherRequestRequiresActionForTaskContext(t *testing.T) {
	request := domain.DialogTeacherRequest{
		EventID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", DialogID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		EventSequence: 2, SourceMessageID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", SourceSequence: 1,
		StudentID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", PersonalTeacherID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
		ContextType: domain.LearningContextPracticeTask, ContextID: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666",
		OccurredAt: time.Date(2026, 8, 30, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
	}
	_, err := domain.NewDialogTeacherRequest(request)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrInvalidDialogContext)
	request.LearningActionID = "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777"
	_, err = domain.NewDialogTeacherRequest(request)
	require.NoError(t, err)
}

func TestDialogTeacherRequestNormalizesTimestampForDurableDeduplication(t *testing.T) {
	request := domain.DialogTeacherRequest{
		EventID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", DialogID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		EventSequence: 2, SourceMessageID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", SourceSequence: 1,
		StudentID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", PersonalTeacherID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
		ContextType: domain.LearningContextPracticeTask, ContextID: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666",
		LearningActionID: "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777",
		OccurredAt:       time.Date(2026, 8, 30, 10, 0, 0, 123456789, time.FixedZone("test", 2*60*60)),
	}

	got, err := domain.NewDialogTeacherRequest(request)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, time.Date(2026, 8, 30, 8, 0, 0, 123456000, time.UTC), got.OccurredAt)
}

func TestDialogTeacherRequestForbidsActionOutsideTaskContext(t *testing.T) {
	request := domain.DialogTeacherRequest{
		EventID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", DialogID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		EventSequence: 2, SourceMessageID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", SourceSequence: 1,
		StudentID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", PersonalTeacherID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
		ContextType: domain.LearningContextLesson, ContextID: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666",
		LearningActionID: "not-an-action", OccurredAt: time.Date(2026, 8, 30, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
	}
	_, err := domain.NewDialogTeacherRequest(request)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrInvalidDialogContext)
	request.LearningActionID = "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777"
	_, err = domain.NewDialogTeacherRequest(request)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrInvalidDialogContext)
	request.LearningActionID = ""
	_, err = domain.NewDialogTeacherRequest(request)
	require.NoError(t, err)
}

func TestDialogRequestContextRequiresExactSourceAsLastMessage(t *testing.T) {
	createdAt := time.Date(2026, 8, 30, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	input := domain.DialogRequestContext{
		DialogID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", StudentID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		PersonalTeacherID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", ContextType: domain.LearningContextPracticeTask,
		ContextID: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666", SourceMessageID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		LearningActionID: "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777",
		Messages: []domain.DialogMessage{{
			ID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", DialogID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
			AuthorType: domain.DialogMessageAuthorUser, SenderID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
			LearningActionID: "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777", Body: "Помоги понять ошибку",
			Status: 1, MessageSequence: 1, LastEventSequence: 2, CreatedAt: createdAt,
		}},
	}
	got, err := domain.NewDialogRequestContext(input)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, input.SourceMessageID, got.Messages[0].ID)
	input.Messages[0].SenderID = "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888"
	_, err = domain.NewDialogRequestContext(input)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrInvalidDialogContext)
	input.Messages[0].SenderID = input.StudentID
	input.Messages[0].LearningActionID = "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888"
	_, err = domain.NewDialogRequestContext(input)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrInvalidDialogContext)
}

func TestDialogRequestContextAllowsPriorActionCycleInSameTaskDialog(t *testing.T) {
	createdAt := time.Date(2026, 8, 30, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	input := domain.DialogRequestContext{
		DialogID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", StudentID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		PersonalTeacherID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", ContextType: domain.LearningContextPracticeTask,
		ContextID: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666", SourceMessageID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		LearningActionID: "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777",
		Messages: []domain.DialogMessage{
			{
				ID: "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa", DialogID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
				AuthorType: domain.DialogMessageAuthorUser, SenderID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
				LearningActionID: "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888", Body: "Предыдущая попытка",
				Status: 1, MessageSequence: 1, LastEventSequence: 2, CreatedAt: createdAt,
			},
			{
				ID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", DialogID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
				AuthorType: domain.DialogMessageAuthorUser, SenderID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
				LearningActionID: "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777", Body: "Новая попытка",
				Status: 1, MessageSequence: 2, LastEventSequence: 3, CreatedAt: createdAt.Add(time.Minute),
			},
		},
	}
	got, err := domain.NewDialogRequestContext(input)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888", got.Messages[0].LearningActionID)
	require.Equal(t, input.LearningActionID, got.Messages[1].LearningActionID)
}

func TestLessonDialogRequiresCurrentVersionedSourceButReadsLegacyHistory(t *testing.T) {
	createdAt := time.Date(2026, 8, 30, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	input := domain.DialogRequestContext{
		DialogID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", StudentID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		PersonalTeacherID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", ContextType: domain.LearningContextLesson,
		ContextID: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666", SourceMessageID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		Messages: []domain.DialogMessage{
			{
				ID: "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa", DialogID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
				AuthorType: domain.DialogMessageAuthorUser, SenderID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
				Body: "Старый вопрос", Status: 1, MessageSequence: 1, LastEventSequence: 1, CreatedAt: createdAt,
				LessonContext: &domain.LessonMessageContext{
					ContentRevision: "2026-08-30T10:00:00Z", SelectedText: "старый фрагмент",
				},
			},
			{
				ID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", DialogID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
				AuthorType: domain.DialogMessageAuthorUser, SenderID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
				Body: "Объясни урок", Status: 1, MessageSequence: 2, LastEventSequence: 2, CreatedAt: createdAt.Add(time.Minute),
				LessonContext: &domain.LessonMessageContext{
					Schema: domain.LessonMessageContextSchemaVersion, Mode: domain.LessonMessageModeOverview,
					CourseID: "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa", LessonID: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666",
					ContentRevision: "2026-08-30T10:01:00Z",
				},
			},
		},
	}

	got, err := domain.NewDialogRequestContext(input)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Empty(t, got.Messages[0].LessonContext.Schema)
	require.Equal(t, domain.LessonMessageModeOverview, got.Messages[1].LessonContext.Mode)

	input.Messages = input.Messages[1:]
	input.Messages[0].LessonContext = &domain.LessonMessageContext{
		ContentRevision: "2026-08-30T10:01:00Z", SelectedText: "legacy source",
	}
	_, err = domain.NewDialogRequestContext(input)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrInvalidDialogContext)
}
